name: geqo_effort
description: Controls the effort level of the Genetic Query Optimizer (GEQO) to balance planning time versus query plan quality.
symptoms: Poor execution performance on complex joins
tuning_tips: Increase geqo_effort for complex queries with many joins to improve plan quality; reduce it when planning time dominates overall query latency. Values above 7–8 yield diminishing returns and significantly increase planning overhead.
